cards.lore: “‘We don't have a moment! Come nightfall these hills will swarm with Orcs!'”

fields.title: Goblin Reinforcements
fields.gameText: When you play this minion, you may heal a [MORIA] minion.
fields.lore: “‘We don't have a moment! Come nightfall these hills will swarm with Orcs!'”

fields.title: Goblin Verstärkung
fields.lore: "Sobald die Nacht hereinbricht, wimmelt es hier nur so von Orks.“

fields.title: Refuerzos Goblin
fields.lore: “¡No disponemos de un momento! ¡Cuando caiga la noche estas colinas estarán atestadas de Orcos!”

fields.title: Renforts Gobelins
fields.lore: « Nous n'avons pas un instant à perdre! À la nuit tombée, ces collines grouilleront d'orques! »

fields.title: Rinforzi Goblin
fields.lore: “‘Non abbiamo tempo! Appena si farà buio queste colline brulicheranno di Orchi!'”

cards.title: Goblin Scrabbler
cards.gameText: When you play this minion, you may discard an [ELVEN] condition. The roaming penalty for each [MORIA] Orc you play is -1.
cards.lore: “Orcs were as keen as hounds on a scent, it was said, but they could also climb.”

fields.title: Goblin Scrabbler
fields.gameText: When you play this minion, you may discard an [ELVEN] condition. The roaming penalty for each [MORIA] Orc you play is -1.
fields.lore: “Orcs were as keen as hounds on a scent, it was said, but they could also climb.”

fields.title: Goblin Sucher
fields.lore: Orks konnten Fährten ebensogut verfolgen wie Hunde, hieß es, und außerdem konnten sie klettern.

fields.title: Escarbador Goblin
fields.lore: “Los Orcos tenían un olfato tan afilado como el de los sabuesos, se decía, pero además podían trepar.”

fields.title: Fouineur Gobelin
fields.lore: « Les orques avaient un flair aussi pénétrant que celui des meilleurs chiens de chasse, disait-on, mais ils pouvaient aussi grimper. »

fields.title: Perlustratore Goblin
fields.lore: “Si diceva che gli Orchi avessero il fiuto più fine di un cane da caccia, e sapevano anche arrampicarsi.”

cards.title: Goblin Spearman
cards.gameText: While bearing a Goblin Spear, this minion is damage +2.
cards.lore: “...with the speed of a striking snake, he charged into the Company and thrust with his spear....”

fields.title: Goblin Spearman
fields.gameText: While bearing a Goblin Spear, this minion is damage +2.
fields.lore: “...with the speed of a striking snake, he charged into the Company and thrust with his spear....”

fields.title: Goblin Speerträger
fields.lore: ...tauchte er mit der Schnelligkeit einer angreifenden Schlange hindurch, stürmte mitten in die Gemeinschaft hinein und stieß seinen Speer genau auf Frodo.

fields.title: Lancero Goblin
fields.lore: “...con la velocidad de una serpiente, cargó entre la Compañía y empujó con su lanza...”

fields.title: Lancier Gobelin
fields.lore: « ... avec la rapidité d'un serpent à l'attaque, il chargea la Compagnie et pointa sa lance... »

fields.title: Lanciere Goblin
fields.lore: “...con la rapidità di un serpente che morde, investì la Compagnia, puntando dritto su Frodo la sua lancia...”

cards.title: Huge Tentacle
cards.gameText: Tentacle. Damage +1. When you play this minion, you may play Watcher in the Water from your draw deck. This minion may not bear possessions and is discarded if not at a marsh.
cards.lore: “Out from the water a long sinuous tentacle had crawled; it was pale-green and luminous and wet.”

fields.title: Huge Tentacle
fields.gameText: Tentacle. Damage +1. When you play this minion, you may play Watcher in the Water from your draw deck. This minion may not bear possessions and is discarded if not at a marsh.
fields.lore: “Out from the water a long sinuous tentacle had crawled; it was pale-green and luminous and wet.”

fields.title: Riesiges Tentakel
fields.lore: Aus dem Wasser war ein langer, gekrümmter Fangarm herausgekrochen; er war blaßgrün, leuchtend und naß.

fields.title: Tentáculo enorme
fields.lore: “Fuera del agua un enorme y sinuoso tentáculo se había arrastrado, era de un verde pálido y luminoso y mojado.”

fields.title: Énorme Tentacule
fields.lore: « Hors de l'eau avait rampé un long tentacule sinueux; il était vert pâle, lumineux et humide. »

fields.title: Tentacolo Enorme
fields.lore: “Dallo stagno era uscito fuori un lungo e sinuoso tentacolo; era verde pallido, luminoso e bagnato.”

cards.title: Moria Archer Troop
cards.gameText: Archer. While you can spot another [MORIA] archer, add 1 to the minion archery total.
cards.lore: Most of the Goblin arrows flew harmlessly into the chasm, but there were so many!

fields.title: Moria Archer Troop
fields.gameText: Archer. While you can spot another [MORIA] archer, add 1 to the minion archery total.
fields.lore: Most of the Goblin arrows flew harmlessly into the chasm, but there were so many!

fields.title: Bogenschützen aus Moria
fields.lore: Die meisten Pfeile der Goblins schwirrten harmlos in die Kluft, aber es waren so viele.

fields.title: Tropa Arquera de moria
fields.lore: La mayoría de las flechas Goblin volaron sin causar daños hacia el abismo, ¡pero había tantas de ellas!

fields.title: Meutes d'Archers
fields.lore: La plupart des flèches lancées par les gobelins tombèrent sans heurt dans le gouffre, mais il y en avait tellement.

fields.title: Schiera di Arcieri di Moria
fields.lore: La maggior parte delle frecce dei Goblin volarono innocue nel crepaccio, ma erano talmente tante!

cards.title: Must Do Without Hope
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert The Balrog to add a burden.
cards.lore: “His enemy halted again, facing him, and the shadow about it reached out like two vast wings.”

fields.title: Must Do Without Hope
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert The Balrog to add a burden.
fields.lore: “His enemy halted again, facing him, and the shadow about it reached out like two vast wings.”

fields.title: Wir müssen es ohne Hoffnung versuchen
fields.lore: Sein Feind blieb wieder stehen und schaute ihn an, und der Schatten um ihn reckte sich wie zwei riesige Flügel.

fields.title: Seguir sin esperanza
fields.lore: “El enemigo se detuvo de nuevo, enfrentándolo, y la sombra que lo envolvía se abrió a los lados como dos vastas alas.”

fields.title: Il Faut Abandonner Tout Espoir
fields.lore: « Son ennemi s'arrêta de nouveau face à lui, et l'ombre qui l'entourait s'étendait comme deux vastes ailes. »

fields.title: Dovremo Fare a Meno della Speranza
fields.lore: “Il nemico si arrestò nuovamente, fronteggiandolo, ed intorno ad esso l'ombra allungò due grandi ali.”

cards.title: Old Differences
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make an Elf or Dwarf skirmishing a [MORIA] Orc strength -1 (or -3 if you spot an Elf and a Dwarf).
cards.lore: “‘I'll be dead before I see the Ring in the hands of an Elf!'”

fields.title: Old Differences
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make an Elf or Dwarf skirmishing a [MORIA] Orc strength -1 (or -3 if you spot an Elf and a Dwarf).
fields.lore: “‘I'll be dead before I see the Ring in the hands of an Elf!'”

fields.title: Alte Zwistigkeiten
fields.lore: "Eher will ich sterben, als dass ich den Ring in den Händen eines Elben sehe!“

fields.title: Viejas diferencias
fields.lore: “¡Antes muerto que ver el Anillo en manos de un Elfo!”

fields.title: Querelles Anciennes
fields.lore: « “Je serai mort avant de voir l'Anneau dans la main d'un Elfe!” »

fields.title: Antiche Divergenze
fields.lore: “‘Sarò morto prima di vedere l'Anello nelle mani di un Elfo!'”

cards.title: Power and Terror
cards.gameText: Shadow: Reveal any number of [MORIA] Orcs from your hand to play The Balrog. Its twilight cost is -2 for each Orc revealed.
cards.lore: “The ranks of the orcs had opened, and they crowded away, as if they themselves were afraid.”

fields.title: Power and Terror
fields.gameText: Shadow: Reveal any number of [MORIA] Orcs from your hand to play The Balrog. Its twilight cost is -2 for each Orc revealed.
fields.lore: “The ranks of the orcs had opened, and they crowded away, as if they themselves were afraid.”

fields.title: Macht und Schrecken
fields.lore: Die Reihen der Orks hatten sich geöffnet, und sie wichen zurück, als ob sie selbst Angst hätten.

fields.title: Poder y terror
fields.lore: “Las filas de los Orcos se abrieron, y se dispersaron, como si ellos mismos estuvieran asustados.”

fields.title: Puissance et Terreur
fields.lore: « Les rangs des orques s'étaient ouverts, et ils reculaient en masse, comme effrayés eux-mêmes. »

fields.title: Potere e Terrore
fields.lore: “I ranghi degli Orchi si erano aperti, ed avevano ceduto il passo raggruppandosi lontano, come se anche loro fossero impauriti.”

cards.title: Throw Yourself in Next Time
cards.gameText: To play, spot a [MORIA] Orc. Plays on a Hobbit companion. Bearer may be exerted only by Shadow cards.
cards.lore: “‘This is a serious journey, not a hobbit walking-party....Now be quiet!'”

fields.title: Throw Yourself in Next Time
fields.gameText: To play, spot a [MORIA] Orc. Plays on a Hobbit companion. Bearer may be exerted only by Shadow cards.
fields.lore: “‘This is a serious journey, not a hobbit walking-party....Now be quiet!'”

fields.title: Wirf dich das nächste Mal selbst hinein
fields.lore: "Unsere Wanderung ist eine ernste Angelegenheit, kein Hobbitspaziergang... Jetzt sei still!“

fields.title: Tírate tú mismo la próxima vez
fields.lore: “Este es un viaje serio, y no una excursión Hobbit... ¡Ahora quédate quieto!”

fields.title: Jetez-Vous Dedans La Prochaine Fois
fields.lore: « “Ce voyage est sérieux, ce n'est pas une promenade de Hobbit... Et maintenant, restez tranquille!” »

fields.title: Gettati Tu Dentro la Prossima Volta
fields.lore: “‘Questo è un viaggio serio, e non una passeggiata hobbit... E ora stai fermo e zitto!'”

cards.title: Troubled Mountains
cards.gameText: Shadow: Exert a [MORIA] minion and spot X burdens to add (X) (limit (5)).
cards.lore: “‘The Dimrill Dale is full of vapour and clouds of smoke....There are noises in the deeps of the earth.'”

fields.title: Troubled Mountains
fields.gameText: Shadow: Exert a [MORIA] minion and spot X burdens to add (X) (limit (5)).
fields.lore: “‘The Dimrill Dale is full of vapour and clouds of smoke....There are noises in the deeps of the earth.'”

fields.title: Aufgewühlte Berge
fields.lore: "Das Schattenbachtal ist voll von Dampf und Rauchwolken... Es kommen Geräusche aus den Tiefen der Erde.“

fields.title: Montañas inquietas
fields.lore: “El Valle del Dimrill está lleno de vapor y nubes de humo... Hay ruidos en las profundidades de la tierra.”

fields.title: Montagnes Troublées
fields.lore: « “La Vallée des Rigoles Sombres est emplie de vapeur et de nuages de fumée... Il y a des bruits dans les profondeurs de la terre.” »

fields.title: Montagne Pericolose
fields.lore: “‘La Valle dei Rivi Tenebrosi è piena di vapori e di nubi di fumo... si odono rumori negli abissi della terra.'”

cards.title: Watcher in the Water
cards.subtitle: Keeper of Westgate
cards.gameText: Damage +1. While you can spot Watcher in the Water, discard all other minions (except tentacles). Each tentacle is strength +2 and damage +1. This minion may not bear possessions and is discarded if not at a marsh.
cards.lore: “The dark water boiled... there was a hideous stench.”

fields.title: Watcher in the Water
fields.subtitle: Keeper of Westgate
fields.gameText: Damage +1. While you can spot Watcher in the Water, discard all other minions (except tentacles). Each tentacle is strength +2 and damage +1. This minion may not bear possessions and is discarded if not at a marsh.
fields.lore: “The dark water boiled... there was a hideous stench.”

fields.title: Der Wächter im Wasser
fields.subtitle: Hüter des Westtors
fields.lore: Das dunkle Wasser brodelte, und es stank abscheulich.

fields.title: Vigilante en el agua
fields.subtitle: guardián de la puerta del Oeste
fields.lore: “El agua oscura hirvió... había un hedor espantoso.”

fields.title: Le Guetteur de l'Eau
fields.subtitle: Gardien de la Porte de l'Ouest
fields.lore: « L'eau noire bouillonna, et une horrible puanteur s'éleva. »

fields.title: Osservatore nell'Acqua
fields.subtitle: Guardiano del Cancello Occidentale
fields.lore: “Le scure acque bollirono ed emanarono un fetido tanfo.”

cards.title: Whip of Many Thongs
cards.gameText: Bearer must be The Balrog. Skirmish: Exert The Balrog to discard a helm, shield, or armor borne by a character The Balrog is skirmishing.
cards.lore: “It raised the whip, and the thongs whined and cracked.”

fields.title: Whip of Many Thongs
fields.gameText: Bearer must be The Balrog. Skirmish: Exert The Balrog to discard a helm, shield, or armor borne by a character The Balrog is skirmishing.
fields.lore: “It raised the whip, and the thongs whined and cracked.”

fields.title: Peitsche mit vielen Riemen
fields.lore: Er hob die Peitsche, und die Riemen wimmerten und knallten.

fields.title: Látigo de muchas colas
fields.lore: “Enseguida esgrimió el látigo, y las colas crujieron y gimieron.”

fields.title: Fouet aux Nombreuses Lanières
fields.lore: « Il leva le fouet, et les lanières gémirent et claquèrent. »

fields.title: Frusta dalle Molte Code
fields.lore: “Il Balrog schioccò la frusta, e le code scricchiarono e fischiarono.”

cards.title: Bill Ferny
cards.subtitle: Swarthy Sneering Fellow
cards.gameText: Nazgul are not roaming. The Free Peoples player may not assign a character to skirmish Bill Ferny. Discard Bill Ferny if underground.
cards.lore: “‘...as for Ferny, he would sell anything to anybody; or make mischief for amusement.'”

fields.title: Bill Ferny
fields.subtitle: Swarthy Sneering Fellow
fields.gameText: Nazgul are not roaming. The Free Peoples player may not assign a character to skirmish Bill Ferny. Discard Bill Ferny if underground.
fields.lore: “‘...as for Ferny, he would sell anything to anybody; or make mischief for amusement.'”

fields.gameText: Nazgul are not roaming. While you can spot a Hobbit, the Free Peoples player may not assign a character to skirmish Bill Ferny. Discard Bill Ferny if underground.

fields.title: Lutz Farning
fields.subtitle: Finsterer Geselle
fields.lore: "...und was Farning betrifft, so würde er jedem alles verraten; oder Unheil anrichten bloß zum Spaß.“

fields.title: Bill Helechal
fields.subtitle: Tipo Sarcástico de Tez Morena
fields.lore: “...y de Helechal, vendería lo que fuera a cualquiera, y causaría problemas por pura diversión.”

fields.title: Bill Fougeron
fields.subtitle: Noiraud Ricaneur
fields.lore: « “... quant à Fougeron, il vendrait n'importe quoi à n'importe qui, ou il ferait du mal par simple plaisir.” »

fields.title: Billy Felci
fields.subtitle: Tipo Oscuro e Sarcastico
fields.lore: “‘...quanto a Felci, venderebbe l'anima e farebbe cattiverie per puro divertimento.'”

cards.title: Helpless
cards.gameText: To play, spot Frodo and a Nazgul. Plays on Sam. Sam's game text does not apply.
cards.lore: “He heard Frodo's voice, but it seemed to come from a great distance, or from under the earth, crying out strange words.”

fields.title: Helpless
fields.gameText: To play, spot Frodo and a Nazgul. Plays on Sam. Sam's game text does not apply.
fields.lore: “He heard Frodo's voice, but it seemed to come from a great distance, or from under the earth, crying out strange words.”

fields.title: Helpless
fields.gameText: Bearer's special abilities cannot be used. Maneuver: Exert a non-enduring Nazgul to transfer this to a Ring-bound companion. Response: If a burden is removed, spot or reveal a Nazgul from hand to transfer this to a Ring-bound companion.

fields.title: Helpless
fields.gameText: To play, spot a Nazgul. Plays on Sam. Bearer's special abilities may not be used.

fields.title: Helpless
fields.gameText: Bearer's special abilities cannot be used. Maneuver: If this is in your support area, exert a Nazgul to transfer this to a Ring-bound companion.

fields.title: Hilflos
fields.lore: Er hörte Frodos Stimme, aber es war, als ob sie aus großer Ferne oder von unter der Erde käme, und sie rief fremdartige Wörter.

fields.title: Desvalido
fields.lore: “Oyó la voz de Frodo, pero esta parecía venir de una gran distancia, o de bajo la tierra, gritando extrañas palabras.”

fields.title: Impuissant
fields.lore: « Il entendait la voix de Frodon, mais elle semblait venir de très loin ou de sous la terre, criant des mots étranges. »

fields.title: Impotente
fields.lore: “Egli aveva udito la voce di Frodo, ma sembrava giungere da molto lontano, o da sotto terra, e gridare strane parole.”

cards.title: His Terrible Servants
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Response: If a twilight Nazgul is about to take a wound, remove (1) to prevent that wound.
cards.lore: “‘...in the dark they perceive many signs and forms that are hidden from us: then they are most to be feared.'”

fields.title: His Terrible Servants
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Response: If a twilight Nazgul is about to take a wound, remove (1) to prevent that wound.
fields.lore: “‘...in the dark they perceive many signs and forms that are hidden from us: then they are most to be feared.'”

fields.title: Seine schrecklichen Diener
fields.lore: "...und in der Dunkelheit nehmen sie viele Zeichen und Formen wahr, die uns verborgen sind: dann sind sie am meisten zu fürchten.

fields.title: Sus terribles servidores
fields.lore: “...en la oscuridad perciben muchos signos y formas que a nosotros nos están ocultas: es entonces cuando más se les debe temer.”

fields.title: Ses Terribles Serviteurs
fields.lore: « “... dans l'obscurité ils perçoivent maints signes et formes qui nous échappent: c'est alors qu'ils sont le plus à craindre.” »

fields.title: I Suoi Terribili Servi
fields.lore: “‘...nell'oscurità percepiscono molti segni e molte figure che per noi sono invisibili: è allora che bisogna temerli maggiormente.'”

cards.title: It Wants to be Found
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Spot a twilight Nazgul to add a burden.
cards.lore: “...perhaps it had tried to reveal itself in response to some wish or command that was felt in the room.”

fields.title: It Wants to be Found
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Spot a twilight Nazgul to add a burden.
fields.lore: “...perhaps it had tried to reveal itself in response to some wish or command that was felt in the room.”

fields.title: Er will gefunden werden
fields.lore: ...vielleicht hat er versucht, sich bemerkbar zu machen, um einem Wunsch oder Befehl zu entsprechen, den er im Raum spürte.

fields.title: Quiere ser encontrado
fields.lore: “...tal vez intentó revelarse a sí mismo en respuesta a algún deseo u orden que se percibió en la sala.”

fields.title: Il Veut Être Trouvé
fields.lore: « ... peut-être avait-il essayé de se révéler en réponse à quelque désir ou ordre senti dans la salle. »

fields.title: Vuole Essere Trovato
fields.lore: “...forse aveva cercato di rivelarsi in risposta a qualche ordine o desiderio che percepiva nella stanza.”

cards.title: Resistance Becomes Unbearable
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a twilight Nazgul to exert the Ring-bearer.If the Ring-bearer is then exhausted, he puts on The One Ring until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: “Not with the hope of escape, or of doing anything, either good or bad: he simply felt that he must take the Ring and put it on his finger.”

fields.title: Resistance Becomes Unbearable
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a twilight Nazgul to exert the Ring-bearer.If the Ring-bearer is then exhausted, he puts on The One Ring until the regroup phase.
fields.lore: “Not with the hope of escape, or of doing anything, either good or bad: he simply felt that he must take the Ring and put it on his finger.”

fields.title: Er vermochte nicht länger zu widerstehen
fields.lore: Nicht in der Hoffnung , zu entkommen oder etwas zu tun, ob es gut oder schlecht war: er hatte einfach das Gefühl, er müsse den Ring nehmen und ihn auf den Finger stecken.

fields.title: La resistencia se vuelve insoportable
fields.lore: “No con la esperanza de huir, o de hacer cualquier cosa, tanto buena como mala; simplemente sintió que debía tomar el Anillo y ponérselo en el dedo.”

fields.title: La Résistance Devient Insupportable
fields.lore: « Non pas dans l'espoir de s'échapper ou de faire quelque chose, de bon ou de mauvais; il sentait simplement qu'il devait prendre l'Anneau et le passer à son doigt. »

fields.title: Resistere Diventa Insopportabile
fields.lore: “Non era la speranza della fuga né uno scopo qualsiasi, buono o malvagio, ma era semplicemente il bisogno di prendere l'Anello e di metterselo al dito.”

cards.title: Stricken Dumb
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert The Witch-king to discard a tale or weapon.
cards.lore: “He felt his tongue cleave to his mouth and his heart labouring. His sword broke and fell out of his shaking hand.”

fields.title: Stricken Dumb
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert The Witch-king to discard a tale or weapon.
fields.lore: “He felt his tongue cleave to his mouth and his heart labouring. His sword broke and fell out of his shaking hand.”

fields.title: Mit Stummheit geschlagen
fields.lore: Er fühlte, wie ihm die Zunge am Gaumen klebte und sein Herz schwer schlug. Sein Schwert zerbarst und fiel ihm aus der Hand.

fields.title: Enmudecido
fields.lore: “Sintió su lengua contraerse en su boca y su corazón latiendo. Su espada se rompió y cayo de su temblorosa mano.”

fields.title: Frappé de Mutisme
fields.lore: « Il sentit sa langue se coller à son palais et son c*ur battre à tout rompre. Son épée se brisa et tomba de sa main tremblante. »

fields.title: Assordati
fields.lore: “Sentì la lingua paralizzarglisi nella bocca e il cuore battere affannosamente. La spada si frantumò e gli cadde dalla mano tremante.”

cards.title: They Will Find the Ring
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert 2 Nazgul and spot X burdens to exert X companions.
cards.lore: “...to the dismay of Frodo and his friends out from the trees and rocks away on the left four other Riders came flying.”

fields.title: They Will Find the Ring
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert 2 Nazgul and spot X burdens to exert X companions.
fields.lore: “...to the dismay of Frodo and his friends out from the trees and rocks away on the left four other Riders came flying.”

fields.title: Sie werden den Ring finden
fields.lore: ...und zu Frodos und seiner Freunde Entsetzen brachen zwischen den Bäumen und Felsen zur Linken noch vier Reiter hervor.

fields.title: Ellos encontrarán el anillo
fields.lore: “...para desánimo de Frodo y de sus amigos de los árboles y rocas del lado izquierdo cuatro Jinetes más llegaron al vuelo.”

fields.title: Ils Trouveront l'Anneau
fields.lore: « ... au grand effroi de Frodon et de ses amis, des bois et des rochers au loin sur la gauche surgirent en trombe quatre autres Cavaliers. »

fields.title: Troveranno l'Anello
fields.lore: “...Frodo e i suoi amici costernati videro sbucare a tutta velocità dagli alberi e dalle rupi alla loro sinistra altri quattro Cavalieri.”

cards.title: Úlairë Attëa
cards.subtitle: The Easterling
cards.gameText: Twilight. When you play Ulaire Attea, you may wound an ally.
cards.lore: “‘They had words with Harry at Westgate on Monday.... He was white and shaking when they left him.'”

fields.title: Úlairë Attëa
fields.subtitle: The Easterling
fields.gameText: Twilight. When you play Ulaire Attea, you may wound an ally.
fields.lore: “‘They had words with Harry at Westgate on Monday.... He was white and shaking when they left him.'”

fields.subtitle: Der Ostling
fields.lore: "Sie sprachen am Montag mit Heinrich am Westtor. ...Er war weiß und zitterte, als sie ihn verließen.“

fields.subtitle: El Oriental
fields.lore: “Tuvieron unas palabras con Enrique en la Puerta del Oeste el lunes... Estaba blanco y temblando cuando se marcharon.”

fields.subtitle: Celui de l'Est
fields.lore: « “Ils ont eu une discussion avec Harry à la Porte de l'Ouest, lundi. ... Il était tout pâle et tremblant quand ils l'ont quitté.” »

fields.subtitle: L'Orientale
fields.lore: “‘Hanno discusso a lungo assieme con Harry, lunedì, al cancello occidentale... era pallido come un cadavere e tremava tutto, quando se ne andarono.'”

cards.title: Úlairë Enquëa
cards.subtitle: Ringwraith in Twilight
cards.gameText: Twilight. Each time Ulaire Enquea wins a skirmish, you may exert him to wound the Ring-bearer once (or twice if you spot 5 burdens).
cards.lore: “In their white faces burned keen and merciless eyes....”

fields.title: Úlairë Enquëa
fields.subtitle: Ringwraith in Twilight
fields.gameText: Twilight. Each time Ulaire Enquea wins a skirmish, you may exert him to wound the Ring-bearer once (or twice if you spot 5 burdens).
fields.lore: “In their white faces burned keen and merciless eyes....”

fields.subtitle: Ringgeist im Zwielicht
fields.lore: In ihren weißen Gesichtern brannten scharfe und gnadenlose Augen...

fields.subtitle: Espectro en la penumbra
fields.lore: “En sus blancos rostros ardían despiadados y afilados ojos...”

fields.subtitle: Spectre Crépusculaire
fields.lore: « Dans leurs figures blanches luisaient des yeux perçants et impitoyables. »

fields.subtitle: Spettro nel Crepuscolo
fields.lore: “Nei loro visi bianchi fiammeggiavano occhi penetranti e spietati...”

cards.title: Úlairë Nelya
cards.subtitle: Ringwraith in Twilight
cards.gameText: Twilight. While you can spot 2 burdens or 2 wounds on the Ring-bearer, Ulaire Nelya is fierce and damage +1.
cards.lore: “Over the lip of the little dell, on the side away from the hill, they felt, rather than saw, a shadow rise, one shadow or more than one.”

fields.title: Úlairë Nelya
fields.subtitle: Ringwraith in Twilight
fields.gameText: Twilight. While you can spot 2 burdens or 2 wounds on the Ring-bearer, Ulaire Nelya is fierce and damage +1.
fields.lore: “Over the lip of the little dell, on the side away from the hill, they felt, rather than saw, a shadow rise, one shadow or more than one.”

fields.subtitle: Ringgeist im Zwielicht
fields.lore: Über den Rand der kleinen Mulde spürten sie eher, als dass sie es sahen, wie sich ein Schatten erhob, ein Schatten oder mehr als einer.

fields.subtitle: Espectro en la penumbra
fields.lore: “Sobre el borde de la pequeña hondonada, en el lado apartado de la colina, sintieron, más que ver, crecer una sombra, una sombra o más de una.”

fields.subtitle: Spectre Crépusculaire
fields.lore: « Par-dessus le bord de la petit combe, du côté opposé à la route, ils sentirent plus qu'ils ne virent se lever une ombre, une ombre ou davantage. »

fields.subtitle: Spettro nel Crepuscolo
fields.lore: “Sull'orlo della piccola conca, dalla parte opposta del colle, sentirono, piuttosto che vederla, un'ombra che si ergeva, un'ombra o forse più di una.”

cards.title: The Witch-king
cards.subtitle: Lord of the Nazgul
cards.gameText: Twilight. Return to Its Master may not be played. Each time The Witch-king wins a skirmish, you may exert him to wound the Ring-bearer twice.
cards.lore: “‘A great king and sorcerer he was of old, and now he wields a deadly fear.'”

fields.title: The Witch-king
fields.subtitle: Lord of the Nazgul
fields.gameText: Twilight. Return to Its Master may not be played. Each time The Witch-king wins a skirmish, you may exert him to wound the Ring-bearer twice.
fields.lore: “‘A great king and sorcerer he was of old, and now he wields a deadly fear.'”

fields.title: The Witch-king
fields.subtitle: Lord of the Nazgul
fields.gameText: Twilight. Return to Its Master cannot be played. Skirmishes involving The Witch-king cannot be canceled. Each time The Witch-king wins a skirmish, you may exert him to wound the Ring-bearer twice.

fields.title: Der Hexenkönig
fields.subtitle: Erster der Nazgûl
fields.lore: "Ein großer König und Hexenmeister war er einstmals, und jetzt verbreitet er eine tödliche Furcht.“

fields.title: El Rey Brujo
fields.subtitle: Señor de los Nazgûl
fields.lore: “Un gran rey y hechicero fue de tiempos antiguos, y ahora ejerce un miedo mortal.”

fields.title: Le Roi-Sorcier
fields.subtitle: Seigneur des Nazgûl
fields.lore: « “Ce fut jadis un grand roi et un grand sorcier, et maintenant il entretient une peur mortelle.” »

fields.title: Il Re Stregone
fields.subtitle: Signore dei Nazgûl
fields.lore: “‘Grande re e grande mago era stato in passato, e ora la sua arma è la paura mortale.'”

cards.title: Wraith-world
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Spot a twilight Nazgul and the Ring-bearer wearing The One Ring to add 3 burdens.
cards.lore: “‘He is passing into the shadow world, he will soon become a wraith like them.'”

fields.title: Wraith-world
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Spot a twilight Nazgul and the Ring-bearer wearing The One Ring to add 3 burdens.
fields.lore: “‘He is passing into the shadow world, he will soon become a wraith like them.'”

fields.title: Welt der Ringgeister
fields.lore: "Er gleitet hinüber in die Schattenwelt, bald wird er ein Geist sein, genau wie sie.“

fields.title: Mundo espectral
fields.lore: “Está entrando en el mundo de las sombras, pronto se convertirá en un espectro como ellos.”

fields.title: Le Monde des Spectres
fields.lore: « “Il passe dans le monde des Ombres. Il sera bientôt un spectre comme eux.” »

fields.title: Mondo degli Spettri
fields.lore: “‘Sta entrando nel mondo delle ombre, e presto diventerà uno spettro come loro.'”

cards.title: The Eye of Sauron
cards.gameText: Shadow: Exert a [SAURON] Orc and spot X burdens to draw X cards (limit 5).
cards.lore: “‘...he has indeed arisen again and left his hold in Mirkwood and returned to his ancient fastness in the Dark Tower of Mordor.'”

fields.title: The Eye of Sauron
fields.gameText: Shadow: Exert a [SAURON] Orc and spot X burdens to draw X cards (limit 5).
fields.lore: “‘...he has indeed arisen again and left his hold in Mirkwood and returned to his ancient fastness in the Dark Tower of Mordor.'”

fields.title: Das Auge Saurons
fields.lore: "...er hat sich wirklich erhoben und sein Versteck im Düsterwald verlassen und ist zurückgekehrt zu seiner alten Festung im Dunklen Turm von Mordor.“

fields.title: El ojo de sauron
fields.lore: “...se ha alzado de nuevo y ha dejado su fortaleza del Bosque Negro y ha regresado a su vieja reclusión en la Torre Oscura de Mordor.”

fields.title: L'*il de Sauron
fields.lore: « “... il s'est en effet levé de nouveau; il a quitté son repaire de la Forêt Noire pour retourner à son ancienne place forte de la Tour Sombre de Mordor”. »

fields.title: L'Occhio di Sauron
fields.lore: “‘...egli s'è messo di nuovo in movimento, abbandonando il suo forte nel Bosco Atro per ritornare ad abitare la vecchia fortezza nella Torre Oscura.'”

cards.title: Memory of Many Things
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a [SAURON] Orc to discard an ally (or 2 [ELVEN] allies).
cards.lore: “‘But my memory reaches back even to the Elder Days.... I have seen three ages in the West of the world, and many defeats, and many fruitless victories.'”

fields.title: Memory of Many Things
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a [SAURON] Orc to discard an ally (or 2 [ELVEN] allies).
fields.lore: “‘But my memory reaches back even to the Elder Days.... I have seen three ages in the West of the world, and many defeats, and many fruitless victories.'”

fields.title: Mannigfaltige Erinnerungen
fields.lore: "Aber meine Erinnerung reicht zurück bis zur Altvorderenzeit. Ich habe drei Zeitalter im Westen erlebt, und viele Niederlagen und fruchtlose Siege.“

fields.title: Recuerdo de muchas cosas
fields.lore: “Pero mi memoria llega aún a los Días Antiguos... He asistido a tres épocas en el mundo del Oeste, y a muchas derrotas, y a muchas estériles victorias.”

fields.title: Souvenir de Multiples Choses
fields.lore: « “Mais ma mémoire porte jusqu'aux Jours Anciens. J'ai vu trois âges dans l'Ouest du monde, et maintes défaites, et maintes victoires sans lendemain.” »

fields.title: Ricordo di Molte Cose
fields.lore: “‘Ma la mia memoria risale fino ai Tempi Remoti... Ho visto tre ere a ovest del mondo, molte sconfitte e molte vittorie inutili.'”

cards.title: Orc Scout
cards.gameText: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [SAURON] minion you play is -1. Response: If an event is played that spots or exerts a ranger, exert or discard this minion to cancel that event.
cards.lore: “‘Orc!...Not very near, and yet too near, it seems.'”

fields.title: Orc Scout
fields.gameText: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [SAURON] minion you play is -1. Response: If an event is played that spots or exerts a ranger, exert or discard this minion to cancel that event.
fields.lore: “‘Orc!...Not very near, and yet too near, it seems.'”

fields.title: Orkspäher
fields.lore: "Orks! ... Nicht sehr nahe und doch zu nah, scheint es.“

fields.title: Explorador Orco
fields.lore: “¡Orcos! ...No muy cerca, pero aun demasiado cerca, parece ser.”

fields.title: Flaireur Orque
fields.lore: « “Des orques!... Pas très proche, mais trop près tout de même, semble-t-il.” »

fields.title: Guida degli Orchi
fields.lore: “‘Orchi!... Non molto vicini, tuttavia non abbastanza lontani per essere innocui, a quanto pare.'”

cards.title: Orc Taskmaster
cards.gameText: Shadow: Exert this minion to add (1).
cards.lore: An Orc acts when the taskmaster promises reward or the whip.

fields.title: Orc Taskmaster
fields.gameText: Shadow: Exert this minion to add (1).
fields.lore: An Orc acts when the taskmaster promises reward or the whip.

fields.title: Ork Sklaventreiber
fields.lore: Ein Ork handelt, wenn der Sklaventreiber Strafe oder Belohnung verspricht.

fields.title: Capataz Orco
fields.lore: Un Orco actúa cuando el capataz promete o una recompensa o el látigo.

fields.title: Contrôleur Orque
fields.lore: Un orque n'agit que lorsque le contrôleur promet une récompense – ou le fouet.

fields.title: Sorvegliante Orco
fields.lore: Un Orco si muove quando il sorvegliante promette una ricompensa o la frusta.

cards.title: Southern Spies
cards.gameText: Response: If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, spot a [SAURON] minion to make the Free Peoples player discard his or her hand.
cards.lore: “‘They will know all the news now, for they have visited Bill Ferny; and probably that Southerner was a spy as well.'”

fields.title: Southern Spies
fields.gameText: Response: If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, spot a [SAURON] minion to make the Free Peoples player discard his or her hand.
fields.lore: “‘They will know all the news now, for they have visited Bill Ferny; and probably that Southerner was a spy as well.'”

fields.gameText: If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, spot a [SAURON] minion to add a burden for each card in the Free Peoples player's hand. The Free Peoples player may discard their hand to prevent this.

fields.title: Spione aus dem Süden
fields.lore: "Sie werden jetzt über alles Bescheid wissen, denn sie haben Lutz Farning besucht; und wahrscheinlich war auch der Südländer ein Späher.“

fields.title: Espías Sureños
fields.lore: “Ya sabrán todas las noticias ahora, porque han visitado a Bill Helechal; y probablemente ese Sureño era un espía también.”

fields.title: Espions Méridionaux
fields.lore: « “Ils doivent tout connaître à présent, car ils sont allés chez Bill Fougeron; et sans doute ce type du Sud était-il un espion, lui aussi.” »

fields.title: Spie del Sud
fields.lore: “‘Sapranno tutto, ormai che si sono incontrati con Billy Felci; e probabilmente quel tipo del Sud era anche lui una spia.'”

cards.title: Spies of Mordor
cards.gameText: Search. To play, spot a [SAURON] Orc. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may draw a card (or 2 cards if you spot a [SAURON] tracker).
cards.lore: “‘Mordor Orcs patrol the Eastern Shore. We must wait for the cover of darkness.'”

fields.title: Spies of Mordor
fields.gameText: Search. To play, spot a [SAURON] Orc. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may draw a card (or 2 cards if you spot a [SAURON] tracker).
fields.lore: “‘Mordor Orcs patrol the Eastern Shore. We must wait for the cover of darkness.'”

fields.title: Spione aus Mordor
fields.lore: "Orks bewachen das Ostufer. Wir warten auf den Einbruch der Dunkelheit.“

fields.title: Espías de mordor
fields.lore: “Orcos de Mordor patrullan la orilla este. Debemos esperar la cobertura de la oscuridad.”

fields.title: Espions du Mordor
fields.lore: « “Des Orques du Mordor patrouillent la rive Est. Nous devons attendre le couvert de la nuit.” »

fields.title: Spie di Mordor
fields.lore: “‘Gli Orchi di Mordor pattugliano la Riva orientale. Dobbiamo attendere che cali l'oscurità.'”

cards.title: Tower Assassin
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert Tower Assassin to wound an ally.
cards.lore: A Ring of Power would not stop the blade of an assassin lying in wait.

fields.title: Tower Assassin
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert Tower Assassin to wound an ally.
fields.lore: A Ring of Power would not stop the blade of an assassin lying in wait.

fields.title: Attentäter des Turms
fields.lore: Ein Ring der Macht vermag nicht, die Klinge eines Attentäters aus dem Hinterhalt zu aufzuhalten.

fields.title: Asesino de la torre
fields.lore: Un Anillo de Poder no detendría la hoja de un asesino acechando.

fields.title: Assassin de la Tour
fields.lore: Même un Anneau de Pouvoir ne peut arrêter la lame d'un assassin en embuscade.

fields.title: Assassino della Torre
fields.lore: Nemmeno un Anello del Potere riuscirebbe a fermare la lama di un assassino in attesa.

cards.title: Verily I Come
cards.gameText: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on the Ring-bearer. Each time the Free Peoples player draws a card (or takes a card into hand) during the fellowship phase, add a burden.
cards.lore: “There was an eye in the Dark Tower that did not sleep. He knew that it had become aware of his gaze.”

fields.title: Verily I Come
fields.gameText: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on the Ring-bearer. Each time the Free Peoples player draws a card (or takes a card into hand) during the fellowship phase, add a burden.
fields.lore: “There was an eye in the Dark Tower that did not sleep. He knew that it had become aware of his gaze.”

fields.title: Wahrlich, ich komme
fields.lore: Da war ein Auge im Dunklen Turm, das nicht ruhte. Er wußte, dass es seinen Blick bemerkt hatte.

fields.title: Vengo de verdad
fields.lore: “Había un ojo en la Torre Oscura que no dormía. Supo que se había dado cuenta de su mirada.”

fields.title: Vraiment Je Viens
fields.lore: « Il y avait dans la Tour Ténébreuse un *il qui ne dormait pas. Il sut que cet *il avait pris conscience de son observation. »

fields.title: Invero Io Arrivo
fields.lore: “Vi era nella Torre Oscura un occhio che non dormiva, che si era accorto dello sguardo di Frodo.”

cards.title: Vile Blade
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a [SAURON] Orc. Bearer is strength +2 while skirmishing a Man or Elf.
cards.lore: The blood of enemies slain that day blackened the edge of the commander's blade.

fields.title: Vile Blade
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a [SAURON] Orc. Bearer is strength +2 while skirmishing a Man or Elf.
fields.lore: The blood of enemies slain that day blackened the edge of the commander's blade.

fields.title: Heimtückische Klinge
fields.lore: Das Blut erschlagener Feinde schwärzte an diesem Tag die Klinge des Anführers.

fields.title: Hoja vil
fields.lore: La sangre de los enemigos exterminados ese día ennegrecía el filo de la hoja del comandante.

fields.title: Lame Infâme
fields.lore: Le sang des ennemis occis ce jour-là noircissait le tranchant de la lame du commandant.

fields.title: Lama Vile
fields.lore: Il sangue dei nemici uccisi quel giorno anneriva il taglio della lama del comandante.

cards.title: Bilbo
cards.subtitle: Well-spoken Gentlehobbit
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Bilbo and discard a tale to discard a Shadow condition from an opponent's support area.
cards.lore: “...as Mr. Baggins was generous with his money, most people were willing to forgive him his oddities and his good fortune.”

fields.title: Bilbo
fields.subtitle: Well-spoken Gentlehobbit
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Bilbo and discard a tale to discard a Shadow condition from an opponent's support area.
fields.lore: “...as Mr. Baggins was generous with his money, most people were willing to forgive him his oddities and his good fortune.”

fields.subtitle: Feiner Edelhobbit
fields.lore: ...und da Herr Beutlin nicht kleinlich war mit seinem Geld, waren die meisten Leute gewillt, ihm seine Seltsamkeiten und sein Glück zu verzeihen.

fields.subtitle: Respetable gentilhobbit
fields.lore: “...como el Señor Bolsón era generoso con su dinero, la mayoría de la gente estaba dispuesta a perdonarle sus excentricidades y su buena suerte.”

fields.title: Bilbon
fields.subtitle: Gentilhobbit Bien Versé
fields.lore: « ...comme M. Sacquet était généreux de son argent, la plupart des gens lui pardonnaient volontiers ses singularités et sa bonne fortune. »

fields.subtitle: Gentilhobbit Dammodo
fields.lore: “...essendo il signor Baggins generoso, la gente gli perdonava facilmente le sue stranezze e la sua fortuna.”

cards.title: Consorting With Wizards
cards.gameText: Tale. Bearer must be Bilbo. Bilbo may not take wounds (except during the archery phase). Fellowship or Regroup: Exert Bilbo or discard this condition to remove (1).
cards.lore: “‘He wasn't always this peculiar! When I were a lad, old Bilbo was a most respectable Hobbit.'”

fields.title: Consorting With Wizards
fields.gameText: Tale. Bearer must be Bilbo. Bilbo may not take wounds (except during the archery phase). Fellowship or Regroup: Exert Bilbo or discard this condition to remove (1).
fields.lore: “‘He wasn't always this peculiar! When I were a lad, old Bilbo was a most respectable Hobbit.'”

fields.title: Umgang mit Zauberern
fields.lore: "Er war nicht immer so sonderbar! Als ich noch ein Junge war, war der alte Bilbo ein höchst ehrbarer Hobbit.“

fields.title: Asociarse con magos
fields.lore: “¡No siempre había sido así de peculiar! Cuando yo era un muchacho, el viejo Bilbo era un Hobbit respetable.”

fields.title: Fréquentations Magiques
fields.lore: « “Il n'a pas toujours été aussi particulier! Lorsque j'étais un jeune garçon, le vieux Bilbon était un Hobbit des plus respectables.” »

fields.title: Frequentare gli Stregoni
fields.lore: “‘Non è sempre stato così strano! Quando ero un bambino, il vecchio Bilbo era un Hobbit assai rispettabile.'”

cards.title: Dear Friends
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Exert a companion to place a Free Peoples card from your discard pile beneath your draw deck (or 2 Free Peoples cards if that companion has the Frodo signet).
cards.lore: “He pressed him for news of himself and of the wide world... and they stayed up far into the night.”

fields.title: Dear Friends
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Exert a companion to place a Free Peoples card from your discard pile beneath your draw deck (or 2 Free Peoples cards if that companion has the Frodo signet).
fields.lore: “He pressed him for news of himself and of the wide world... and they stayed up far into the night.”

fields.title: Gute Freunde
fields.lore: Er bestürmte ihn mit Fragen, wie es ihm ergangen sei und was es Neues in der weiten Welt gebe... und sie blieben bis weit in die Nacht auf.

fields.title: Amigos queridos
fields.lore: “Le preguntó por noticias de si mismo y de todo el mundo... y estuvieron despiertos hasta muy entrada la noche.”

fields.title: Chers Amis
fields.lore: « Il le pressa de lui donner des nouvelles de lui-même et du vaste monde... et ils veillèrent fort avant dans la nuit. »

fields.title: Cari Amici
fields.lore: “Sollecitò notizie sul suo conto e sul resto del mondo... e rimasero in piedi fino a molto tardi.”

cards.title: Deft in Their Movements
cards.gameText: Stealth. Regroup: Spot 2 Hobbits to make each site's Shadow number -2 until the end of the turn.
cards.lore: “They possessed from the first the art of disappearing swiftly and silently, when large folk who they do not wish to meet come blundering by.”

fields.title: Deft in Their Movements
fields.gameText: Stealth. Regroup: Spot 2 Hobbits to make each site's Shadow number -2 until the end of the turn.
fields.lore: “They possessed from the first the art of disappearing swiftly and silently, when large folk who they do not wish to meet come blundering by.”

fields.title: Geschickt in ihren Bewegungen
fields.lore: Von Anfang an beherrschten sie die Kunst, rasch und geräuschlos zu verschwinden, wenn große Leute, denen sie nicht begegnen wollen, dahertrapsen.

fields.title: Hábiles en sus movimientos
fields.lore: “Dominaron desde un principio el arte de desaparecer rápido y en silencio, cuando la Gente Grande con la que no querían tropezar se les acercaba casualmente.”

fields.title: Adroits dans leurs Mouvements
fields.lore: « Ils ont toujours eu l'art de disparaître vivement et en silence quand des Grandes Gens qu'ils ne désirent pas rencontrer viennent par hasard de leur côté... »

fields.title: Svelti nei Movimenti
fields.lore: “Sin dall'inizio possedevano l'arte di sparire veloci e silenziosi al sopraggiungere di genti che non desideravano incontrare.”

cards.title: Fearing the Worst
cards.gameText: Stealth. To play, exert 2 Hobbits. Plays to your support area. The twilight cost of each search card and each tracker is +2.
cards.lore: “‘Even if we are allowed to leave Bree unhindered, we can hardly hope now to leave it unnoticed.'”

fields.title: Fearing the Worst
fields.gameText: Stealth. To play, exert 2 Hobbits. Plays to your support area. The twilight cost of each search card and each tracker is +2.
fields.lore: “‘Even if we are allowed to leave Bree unhindered, we can hardly hope now to leave it unnoticed.'”

fields.title: Das Schlimmste befürchten
fields.lore: "Selbst wenn man uns ungehindert aus Bree hinauslässt, können wir kaum hoffen, es unbemerkt zu verlassen.“

fields.title: Temiendo lo peor
fields.lore: “Aunque consigamos dejar Bree sin estorbos, no podemos esperar que lo hagamos sin ser vistos.”

fields.title: Redouter le Pire
fields.lore: « “Même s'il nous est permis de quitter librement Bree, nous ne pouvons plus guère espérer partir inaperçus.” »

fields.title: Temendo il Peggio
fields.lore: “‘Anche se riusciamo a lasciare Brea senza troppe difficoltà, non possiamo certo sperare di partire inosservati.'”

cards.title: Filibert Bolger
cards.subtitle: Wily Rascal
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Exert a Hobbit companion twice to cancel a fierce skirmish involving that Hobbit.
cards.lore: Filibert knows paths and tracks that few have trodden. He is not adventurous by nature, but his escapades often require rapid departures.

fields.title: Filibert Bolger
fields.subtitle: Wily Rascal
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Exert a Hobbit companion twice to cancel a fierce skirmish involving that Hobbit.
fields.lore: Filibert knows paths and tracks that few have trodden. He is not adventurous by nature, but his escapades often require rapid departures.

fields.gameText: Skirmish: Exert a Hobbit companion twice (except the Ring-bearer) to cancel a fierce skirmish involving that Hobbit.

fields.subtitle: Gerissener Lausbube
fields.lore: Filibert kannte viele Wege und Ecken, die selten genutzt wurden. Er ist kein Draufgänger, aber seine zahlreichen Eskapaden verlangen oft nach einem raschen Verschwinden.

fields.title: Filiberto Bolger
fields.subtitle: Granuja astuto
fields.lore: Filiberto conoce caminos que pocos han recorrido. No es aventurero por naturaleza, pero sus escapadas a menudo requerían huídas rápidas.

fields.title: Philibert Bolger
fields.subtitle: Malin Vaurien
fields.lore: Philibert connait des sentiers et des pistes rarement empruntés. Il n'est pas aventurier de nature, mais ses entourloupes nécessitent souvent des départs rapides.

fields.title: Filiberto Bolgeri
fields.subtitle: Furfante Astuto
fields.lore: Filiberto conosce sentieri e piste che pochi hanno percorso. Non è di carattere avventuroso, ma le sue scappatelle spesso richiedono rapide fughe.

cards.title: Frodo
cards.subtitle: Reluctant Adventurer
cards.gameText: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). The cost of each artifact, possession, and [SHIRE] tale played on Frodo is -1.
cards.lore: “‘I am not made for perilous quests. I wish I had never seen the Ring! Why did it come to me? Why was I chosen?'”

fields.title: Frodo
fields.subtitle: Reluctant Adventurer
fields.gameText: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). The cost of each artifact, possession, and [SHIRE] tale played on Frodo is -1.
fields.lore: “‘I am not made for perilous quests. I wish I had never seen the Ring! Why did it come to me? Why was I chosen?'”

fields.subtitle: Abenteurer wider Willen
fields.lore: "Denn ich bin nicht geeignet für gefährliche Unternehmungen. Ich wollte, ich hätte den Ring nie gesehen! Warum ist er nur auf mich gekommen? Warum wurde ich erwählt?“

fields.subtitle: Aventurero reluctante
fields.lore: “No estoy hecho para búsquedas peligrosas. ¡Desearía no haber visto nunca el Anillo! ¿Porqué vino a mí? ¿Porqué fui yo el elegido?”

fields.title: Frodon
fields.subtitle: Aventurier Malgré Lui
fields.lore: « “Je ne suis pas fait pour les quêtes périlleuses. Je voudrais bien n'avoir jamais vu l'Anneau! Pourquoi m'est-il venu? Pourquoi ai-je été choisi?” »

fields.subtitle: Avventuriero Riluttante
fields.lore: “‘Non sono affatto amante delle imprese perigliose. Cosa darei per non aver mai visto quest'Anello! Perché è toccato a me? Come mai sono stato scelto io?'”

cards.title: Hobbit Sword-play
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a Hobbit bearing a weapon to wound a minion. That minion's owner may remove (3) to prevent this.
cards.lore: Boromir sensed that a blade in a Halfling's hand would surprise a larger foe.

fields.title: Bella Imitazione

fields.lore: "...unsere Gestalten werfen in ihrem Geist Schatten, die nur die Mittagssonne zerstört...“

fields.title: No son temidos a la luz del día
fields.lore: “...nuestras figuras proyectan sombras en su mente, que sólo el sol del mediodía destruye...”

fields.title: Ils Ne Sont Pas à Craindre au Soleil

fields.title: Senza Paura alla Luce del Sole
fields.lore: “‘...le nostre forme proiettano ombre nelle loro menti, che soltanto il sole di mezzogiorno può distruggere...'”

“Con un ultimo sforzo spossante... Frodo si tolse l'Anello dal dito e lo strinse forte nella mano destra.”

fields.title: Exterminadora de Orcos

fields.title: Le Fléau des Orques
fields.lore: « Glamdring brilla d'une pâle lumière et les tranchants de Dard étincelèrent. »

fields.title: Flagello degli Orchi
fields.lore: “Glamdring emanava un pallido bagliore, e Pungolo irradiava luce dalla lama.”

fields.subtitle: M. Touque

fields.title: Pipino
fields.subtitle: Signor Tuc
fields.lore: “Pipino era evidentemente molto lusingato dall'attenzione che riusciva a concentrare e pareva del tutto dimentico del pericolo che li minacciava.”

fields.lore: "Aber ich bin froh, Sam. Ich kann dir gar nicht sagen, wie froh. Komm mit! Es ist klar, dass wir dazu ausersehen sind, zusammen zu gehen.“

fields.title: Una promesa
fields.lore: “Pero estoy contento, Sam. No te puedo decir cuanto de contento. ¡Vamos! Es llano allá donde vamos los dos juntos.”

fields.title: Une Promesse
fields.lore: « “Mais je suis heureux, Sam. Je ne peux pas te dire à quel point. Viens! Il est clair que nous étions censés partir ensemble.” »

fields.title: Una Promessa
fields.lore: “‘Ma ne sono felice, Sam. Non sai quanto. Andiamo! E' chiaro che il destino vuole che viaggiamo insieme!'”

fields.title: Libro rojo de la frontera del oeste
fields.lore: “¿Acaso no tienen las aventuras un final? Supongo que no. Siempre hay alguien que deba continuar con la historia.”

fields.title: Le Livre Rouge de la Marche de l'Ouest
fields.lore: « “Les aventures n'ont-elles donc jamais de fin? Je suppose que non. Quelqu'un d'autre doit poursuivre l'histoire.” »

fields.title: Libro Rosso dei Confini Occidentali
fields.lore: “‘Possibile che le avventure non abbiano una fine? Ma forse no. C'è sempre qualcun altro che prosegue la storia.'”

fields.subtitle: Vero Poeta

fields.lore: “En las ruinas de los Enanos, la cabeza de un enano será menos fácil de confundir que la de los Elfos, los Hombres o los Hobbits.”

fields.subtitle: Nain de Sang de Montagne
fields.lore: « “Dans les ruines des Nains, il sera plus difficile de faire perdre la tête à un Nain qu'à des Elfes, des Hommes ou des Hobbits.” »

fields.subtitle: Nano della Stirpe delle Montagne
fields.lore: “‘Fra le rovine dei Nani, la testa di un Nano sarà meno stupefacente che non la presenza di Elfi, Uomini o Hobbit.'”

fields.subtitle: El peregrino gris
fields.lore: “Cuando la tarde era gris en la Comarca / se oían sus pasos en la colina; / y se iba antes del alba / en silencio a sitios remotos.”

fields.subtitle: Le Pèlerin Gris
fields.lore: « Quand le soir dans la Comté était gris / Ses pas sur la colline résonnèrent; / Avec l'aurore il s'en alla / Pour un long voyage sans dire mot. »

fields.subtitle: Il Grigio Pellegrino
fields.lore: “‘Grigia era la sera nella Contea, / il suo passo si udì sulla Collina; / ma prima che brillasse l'alba argentea, / già era partito per la sua via.'”
